payout_quote: Earn* up to $260 in eGift Card Rewards After Your First Platelet Donation! At each donation, you'll get a $20 eGift Card and a OneBlood gift. ... 2nd Donation: $20 Bonus Bucks eGift Card + $20 eGift Card; 3rd: $20 Bonus Bucks + $20; 4th: $30 + $20; 5th: $30 + $20; 6th: $40 + $20. After your sixth donation, the Challenge repeats! If you donate every two weeks, you can complete up to four Platelet Challenges per year. ... Whole Blood: Earn* up to $125 in eGift Card Rewards After Your First Whole Blood Donation! 1st: $20 eGift Card; 2nd: $10 Bonus Bucks + $20; 3rd: $15 + $20; 4th: $20 + $20.
timing: eGift cards issued per donation and as Bonus Bucks per challenge level
eligibility: Standard blood/platelet donor eligibility (18+, good health, pass screening); platelet donations every 2 weeks; challenge window: 21 days for platelet, 30 days for whole blood
steps: Donate whole blood or platelets at OneBlood (first donation gets a $20 eGift card)
For platelets: keep donating every 2 weeks within each 21-day challenge window
Each level adds Bonus Bucks ($20-$40) on top of the $20 per-donation eGift card
Complete all 6 platelet levels for up to $260; the challenge then REPEATS (up to 4x/year)
catches: Payout is in eGift cards, not cash — spendable but not cash in hand.
Whole blood challenge is 30 days / 4 donations (up to $125); platelets pay more but take ~2 hours per donation.
You must donate within the challenge window or the Bonus Bucks clock resets.
Platelet donations every 2 weeks is a real time commitment.
biggest_catch: This is gift-card income, not cash — and the big $260 only unlocks if you complete all 6 platelet donations inside each 21-day window.

repeatable.cadence: The platelet challenge repeats after your 6th donation — donating every two weeks completes up to 4 full challenges per year; the $20-per-donation eGift card is ongoing.
repeatable.note: Platelet challenge repeats after the 6th donation — up to 4 full challenges per year donating every two weeks. Per-donation $20 eGift is ongoing.

maximize: Platelets beat whole blood: $260 vs $125 and the challenge repeats 4x/year for up to ~$1040/year in gift cards. Set a standing every-2-weeks appointment so you never miss a 21-day window. Stack the $20/donation eGift with the escalating Bonus Bucks — later levels pay more.

who_pays: OneBlood pays in eGift cards — not cash — issued per donation, plus Bonus Bucks eGift cards as you climb each challenge's levels. This is gift-card rewards, never money in hand.
who_qualifies: Standard blood/platelet donor eligibility: 18+, good health, and you must pass the screening each visit. Platelet donations run every 2 weeks; each challenge has its own window (21 days for platelets, 30 days for whole blood). Failing the day's screening means no donation and no eGift card.
work_available: The Challenges program is live on oneblood.org as of 2026-09-23 (2026-dated content, no stated end date). OneBlood is a volunteer donor organization running blood drives and centers — this is a rewards program, not plasma-center cash.
what_gets_accepted: Completed donations inside the challenge window only — miss the 21-day (platelet) or 30-day (whole blood) window and the Bonus Bucks clock resets. During special promotions that give out festival or sports tickets, donors do not receive the $20 eGift card.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Platelet donations take about 2 hours per visit; whole blood about 1 hour. Platelets every 2 weeks is a real ongoing commitment, plus travel to drives or centers — all unpaid time, for gift-card rewards, not cash.
when_cash_arrives: You get a $20 eGift card at each donation plus Bonus Bucks eGift cards as you complete challenge levels — eGift cards, not cash, issued around the time of each donation.
